steps.analysis: This global action depends only on launching the Markor app; it can fail if the app is missing, not installed under the expected name, or does not reach a recognizable Markor screen.
steps.snippet:
device.open_app("Markor")
device.settle(1.0)

if not any([
    device.find(text="Markor"),
    device.find(description="Files"),
    device.find(description="Create a new file or folder"),
]):
    raise RuntimeError("Markor did not open to a recognizable screen")

steps.analysis: This action depends on the file row being visible as a clickable element whose description is “File <file_name>” (possibly without the extension); it fails if the row is missing, renamed, or not currently visible.
This action depends on a clickable “Delete” control being visible after the target note is selected; indexes may change, and it can fail if the control is absent or not rendered.

This action depends on the delete confirmation dialog being present and identifying its affirmative button by the visible label “OK”. On another instance, the dialog may take a moment to appear or the OK button may not be uniquely identifiable if searched too early, so it must be looked up semantically rather than by index.
steps.snippet:
device.settle(0.5)
idx = device.find(text='OK', clickable=True)
if idx is None:
    raise RuntimeError('Delete confirmation OK button not found')
device.click(index=idx)

steps.analysis: This action only launches the Markor app and does not depend on any element index; it can fail if the app is missing or the launcher cannot bring it forward.

This long-press depends on the file row being identifiable by its description `File {file_name}`; it can fail if `binding["file_name"]` omits or includes the `.md` extension differently from the UI description.
This action depends on the target file being selected and the Delete command being reachable; otherwise it can delete the wrong file or fail if the action is hidden in the overflow menu.
This action depends on the delete confirmation dialog exposing an “OK” button; it can fail if the dialog is not present or the button text/attributes differ across instances.
steps.snippet:
idx = device.find(text="OK", class_name="Button", clickable=True)
if idx is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Delete confirmation OK button not found")
device.click(index=idx)

steps.analysis: This is a global app-launch action, so it does not depend on any element index or the file name; it can fail only if the Markor app cannot be opened.
This long-press depends on locating the file list row whose content description is “File <name>”; it can fail if the recorded index shifts or if binding.file_name omits the .md extension.
This action depends on a selected file being present and the toolbar/overflow “Delete” control being visible; it can fail if the Delete control is not rendered or not clickable.
steps.snippet:
idx = device.find(description='Delete', clickable=True)
if idx is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Delete action not found; ensure the target note is selected and the Delete control is visible.")
device.click(index=idx)
device.settle(0.5)

steps.analysis: This click depends on the delete confirmation dialog being visible and exposing a clickable “OK” button; it can fail if the dialog is missing, the button text differs, or the UI is still animating.
steps.snippet:
device.settle(0.5)
idx = device.find(text='OK', clickable=True)
if idx is None:
    raise RuntimeError('Delete confirmation OK button not found')
device.click(index=idx)
